title.suggested: Mike McCoole Reported Seeking Match with Tom Allen

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that Ned O'Baldwin and Tom Kelly had arrived in St. Louis to prepare for a sparring exhibition, and that Mike McCoole was said to want a match with Tom Allen.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Missouri Democrat, Saturday morning, Dec. 30, 1871

facts.fact: Mike McCoole was reported to be wanting to make a match with Allen

notes: The paper only says 'it is reported'; the main item is about O'Baldwin and Kelly arriving.
